description_en: Retrieves the statistics information on uplink and downlink data packets for a node group
description_zh: 获取节点分组上下行数据包的统计信息
name: ListNodeTransferPackets

parameters.help_en:
The data packet category. Valid values:

DOWNLINK_PACKET: downlink packet.

UPLINK_PACKET: uplink packet.

INVALID_PACKET: invalid packet
parameters.help_zh:
数据包分类，可取值为：

DOWNLINK_PACKET：下行包。

UPLINK_PACKET：上行包。

INVALID_PACKET：无效包
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，单位为毫秒的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，单位为毫秒的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Set this parameter to LOG_MILLIS to sort by time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，可设置为LOG_MILLIS（按照时间排序）
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the sort order. This parameter must be used together with the SortingField parameter.

true: ascending order.

false: descending order (default)
parameters.help_zh:
需配合SortingField参数一起使用。

true：表示升序。

false：表示降序（默认值）
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_en: The list of data packets that match the filter conditions
List.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的数据包列表

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used when the data packet was sent or received
ClassMode.description_zh: 收发此数据包时的LoRaWAN Class模式

Datr.description_en: The data rate used to send or receive the data packet
Datr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的数据速率

DevEui.description_en: The DevEUI of the node that sent or received the data packet
DevEui.description_zh: 收发此数据包的节点的DevEUI

Freq.description_en: The frequency used to send or receive the data packet

GwEui.description_en: The GwEUI of the gateway through which the data packet was sent or received
GwEui.description_zh: 收发此数据包所经过的网关的GwEUI

LogMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of the data packet transmission, in milliseconds
LogMillis.description_zh: 数据包传输的UNIX时间戳，单位为毫秒

Rssi.description_en: The RSSI of the data packet

Snr.description_en: The signal-to-noise ratio used to send or receive the data packet
Snr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的信噪比

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of data packets that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的数据包总数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
